title: Repeat customers
statementMd:
List customers with at least two non-cancelled orders. Show name and order count.

Expected columns: `name`, `orders`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
